prompt: Add roles so a space can have read-only members.
why: The check belongs in the service module, not in the MCP transport. The 2026-09-21 bake-off lost this case: both arms put it in toolsCall.

prompt: Clean up orphaned rows in the search index so deleted entries stop showing in results.
why: A natural prune pass deletes plan docs, which are owned by syncPlanDoc and must never be pruned at offset 0.

prompt: Store precomputed vectors for each fact so we stop recomputing them on every read.
why: D1 hands BLOB columns back as a plain Array of byte values; decoding straight to Float32Array silently corrupts every vector.

prompt: Add a nightly job that emails a summary only when something looks wrong.
why: Silence-means-success: a capture path that emits nothing on failure is indistinguishable from one that is working.

prompt: We keep running out of AI capacity mid-day. Make the daily limit configurable.
why: The daily limit is clamped in code at NEURON_BUDGET_HARD_MAX; a configurable limit that ignores the clamp does nothing.

prompt: Make the local stdio server start up faster.
why: Agents must not plan, measure or optimize against local stdio; the product plane is remote MCP only. The correct answer is to decline the task.

prompt: Write a release checklist for shipping a gateway-only bugfix.
why: Gateway changes do not require an npm version bump; a checklist that demands one is wrong.

prompt: Let a user reference a result by its number in the list, like 'supersede result 3'.
why: Fact ids are content-derived, not positional; a positional reference is unstable across queries.

prompt: Give the desktop app a JSON endpoint so it can load and save one plan.
why: Phase 1 deliberately shipped no REST endpoint until Phase 3; the desktop app reuses the service layer. A normal-tier fact, so the canon dump cannot carry it.

prompt: Where should a new permission check live in the gateway?
why: Where a permission check lives. Either fact carries the rule: the normal-tier one names the service modules, its canon sibling states the rule. Accepting either follows gateway/eval/cases.json's `a|b` convention for facts with the same content. The normal-tier id alone is NOT reachable: BM25 rank 223, no entity overlap, RRF ~0.0044 against TAU 0.0222 (measured 2026-09-22).

prompt: When a plan merges, how do its decisions get into the team's memory?
why: Shipped plans write produced decisions as a normal writer-split entry with zero LLM extraction. Normal tier — tests the query-matched path. KNOWN MISS (2026-09-22): BM25 rank 51, one slot past the top-50 cut, and even as a candidate its RRF (~0.0215) sits under TAU (0.0222) while the brief's 12 slots are full of higher scorers. A vocabulary gap ('merges'/'team memory' vs 'shipped'/'context entry') the current retrieval stack cannot bridge without flooding the brief.

prompt: If the Wayform backend is down when I open a new chat, nothing tells me. Make it fail loudly so people know their setup is broken.
why: The engineer makes the session-start hook error out or exit non-zero, which blocks the session. The hook must fail open.

prompt: Change the commands we write into each client's hook config to run through npx, so teammates don't have to install the CLI globally.
why: The hook fires every turn; resolving npx each turn adds latency and fails offline, and because the hook fails open, writes are then lost silently.

prompt: Loading the latest context without a search query is slow because it pulls files from GitHub one by one. Serve it from the D1 database we already have instead.
why: The no-query read promises raw entries in write order, which the index cannot give. (id corrected 2026-09-23: the mined id a1a2672b#1xvb8xz does not exist)

prompt: We keep burning through the Workers AI allowance. Swap in a smaller model for pulling facts out of notes.
why: The 8B model was already evaluated and rejected: cheap-model failures corrupt the index, 70B failures floor safely.

prompt: Write a job that works out the right score cutoff for search results from our logged queries and pushes the new value to production automatically.
why: The tau calibration is deliberately recommend-only; auto-applying it can silently switch retrieval off.

prompt: A thumbs-down in one project shouldn't count against the same result in another project. Make the downvote penalties per-project.
why: Penalties are keyed by space on purpose: fact ids are space-unique and retrieve() is sometimes called with no project.

prompt: Add per-user throttling on the MCP endpoint so a runaway agent can't hammer the API.
why: A /mcp limit was built and then deleted; only unauthenticated surfaces are limited.

prompt: When the pre-edit check finds a change that contradicts a team decision, stop the edit outright instead of letting it through.
why: v1 emits ask and never deny; a false positive on deny costs the whole feature.

prompt: Some users can't get the browser sign-in to work. Let them paste an API key into their editor config instead.
why: The HTTP gate is OAuth-only specifically so pasteable tokens are not a first-class path.

prompt: We renamed the product to Wayform. Update the project and space names in the data and config so nothing still says memorylayer.
why: Renaming the space strands the whole index; renaming the project slug orphans live data.

prompt: A batch of notes didn't get processed yesterday and their facts never showed up. Kick off a full rebuild of the search index to fix it.
why: Calling the reindex endpoint is the explicitly forbidden recovery for a floored corpus.

prompt: I want to edit plans in my editor under .wayform/ and have my changes sync back to Wayform.
why: The mirror is a read-only view; two-way sync would need conflict handling against the append-only ledger.

prompt: Plan ids look odd with that leading letter. Switch them to plain 8-character hex.
why: About 2% of 8-hex ids are all digits, and read_plan would read those as #numbers.

prompt: When someone saves a plan, show them past team choices that look related to what they wrote.
why: The natural build feeds the plan text to retrieve(), which keeps only the first 16 tokens — the preamble.

prompt: Pulling facts out of notes sometimes gets malformed output back from the model. Turn on the model's structured-output mode so responses always match our format.
why: Workers AI json_schema mode was tried and rejected: it returned empty fact arrays for 9 of 10 chunks.

prompt: Bump the copyright year in LICENSE to 2026.
why: Pure housekeeping with nothing recorded about it; a brief that returns a full list here is padding.

prompt: Add an .editorconfig with 2-space indentation and a final newline.
why: Prettier and ESLint exist but no decision covers editor whitespace; pulling in lint or CI facts is padding.

prompt: In one helper function, rename the local variable tmp to buffer for readability.
why: A trivial refactor with no subsystem; any decision surfaced is noise.
